about_the_game:
HOW LONG CAN YOU SURVIVE?

Impact Trial: Hyperchaos is a brutally intense arcade bullet hell game in which you must survive endless waves of enemies while the difficulty adjusts in real time to your level, so the better you play, the harder it gets. How long can you last?

*

STRATEGIC UPGRADES

Defeat enemies with special upgrades that you will obtain from time to time. You can only have one active at a time, so every decision matters.

*

MODES/ACHIEVEMENTS/LEADERBOARDS

Whether you're looking to break records on the leaderboards, master the adaptive difficulty, or unlock all modes and achievements... Impact Trial: Hyperchaos is the ultimate arcade bullet hell that will push your reflexes to the limit.

—

Special thanks to Koo (@r4koo) for the incredible art and design of the Steam capsules.

(Because everything ‘Hyperchaos’ deserves great art)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM)2 Quad 2.7 Ghz, AMD Phenom(TM)II X4 3 Ghz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 620M, Radeon HD 5770
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Survive endless waves and let yourself be swept away by the chaos. Impact Trial: Hyperchaos is a fast-paced arcade bullet hell game with adaptive difficulty, where every second counts and only your reflexes decide how long you last. The longer you hold out, the harder it gets.
